payload.summary: verify:phone-chrome exit 0 after a correct selector skip is indistinguishable from a full browser pass in caller reports
payload.detail: Measured 2026-08-22 while running the A2 browser gates for issue #2270. Invoked bare on a clean main checkout, verify:phone-chrome derived its inputs from the working-tree diff, found only one untracked docs/outstanding-issues-inbox JSON, printed 'Note: No phone-chrome-affecting file was detected; only prerequisite checks were selected', ran docs:check-index and docs:check-links, and exited 0. That skip is intended: documentation-only inputs are pinned to those two documentation checks (tests/verify-phone-chrome.test.ts), and the selector is not wrong to omit browser tests when no phone-chrome-affecting path changed. Making the skip path non-zero would break legitimate docs-only verification. The remaining process issue is reporting, not selection: nothing browser-related executed, yet the exit code is indistinguishable from a full Chromium pass. This is the exact false-green class AGENTS.md's evidence rule exists to catch: exit 0 alone is not proof. Reporting that run as 'verify:phone-chrome green' would have been wrong. The real gate only engaged after passing an explicit --files list of the merged Dictionary scope (git diff --name-only 66594ddc1^1..main filtered to src/ and tests/ui-), which then selected lock-parity, runtime, contracts, focused-browser and full-ui and produced 133 contract tests, 12 focused phone journeys and 473 Chromium tests, all green. Suggested fix: keep the skip-and-exit-0 contract, but make the skip a named non-proof outcome that evidence rules must quote (a distinct skip token in stdout, or a required 'skipped — no phone-chrome files' report line) so a caller cannot treat 'nothing selected' as 'everything passed'.
